{{Quote|The Naboo system is huge! Where are we going to start?|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>}}
The '''Naboo system''' was a large [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Erep]] and [[Widow]] as well as their moons. It was centered around the star [[Naboo (star)/Legends|Naboo]]. It was kept clean and free of smugglers by the RNSF ([[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]) and their trained pilots. However, [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lords such as [[Gorr Desilijic Ebelt]] and [[Borvo]] along with their henchmen lurked in the fringes of the system. It was home to humans such as [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] & [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and Gungans such as [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]].
